# Go Lang Starter

> A production-minded foundation for multilingual CMS, back-office, and future SaaS products.

Go Lang Starter is a suite of independently versioned applications connected by immutable API contracts:

- Go API: Gin, permission-driven authorization, runtime localization, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB/XAMPP portability.
- Vue Admin: secure cookie sessions, accessible administration workflows, and exact permission checks.
- Astro Site: server-rendered locale URLs, semantic HTML, canonical links, hreflang, and structured data.

## Public pages

- [English](https://tewarach-dev.me/en/)
- [Thai](https://tewarach-dev.me/th/)

Locale availability and translated content are resolved at runtime. The public site does not silently substitute content from a different locale when a requested locale is unavailable.
